title: Empty technician groups and an empty Unassigned show 'No work orders'
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and "Jenny Wilson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard, S1-691 led by Ralph Edwards, S1-352 with no lead, nothing led by Jenny Wilson):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Find Jenny Wilson's group and read what it shows.
  5. Click Search and type the number of the work order led by Esther Howard (e.g. S1-702).
  6. Read what Ralph Edwards' group, Jenny Wilson's group and Unassigned show.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Jenny Wilson has a group even though she leads no work orders, and it shows the text "No work orders".
  • With the search on, Esther Howard's group lists S1-702, and Ralph Edwards' group, Jenny Wilson's group and Unassigned each show "No work orders".
  • The design shows "No work orders assigned": that wording is a fail against the specification, write down what you see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R14, S2-R15, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 DR-40. PRD inline comment Chris Ward 25 Sep 2026 (empty groups read "No work orders").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R14: “Show every eligible technician even without matching work, except while Assigned to me is enabled (S2-R9), subject to the filtered-empty state in S1-N1.”
  • S2-R15: “A technician group with no work orders under the current filters, and an empty Unassigned group, show the text “No work orders”.”
